move.subject: Re: New stainless pump shaft SH-220: award one of two suppliers
move.body:
Dear your company team,

Your brief quote and return to the machines suggest you value a straightforward discussion that leaves you focused on production. We want a competitive agreement that is practical for you to deliver. How could flexibility in delivery timing and payment help you sharpen your price?

We confirm a binding volume of 6,000 units per year for 24 months. We have an offer at EUR 16.00 per unit (offer:DEMO-C1-0). Our should-cost estimate for this part is on record (cost:part:SH-220). Our demand forecast for this part is on record (fc:SH-220@2026-09).

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 12.51 per unit, 30 days payment, 42 days lead time, DAP). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Attached: our monthly call-off schedule for the full contract term.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Hallo,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the rival quote data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.

Hallo, we looked at your numbers and the 6,000 units, and we can do DAP and 42 days lead time. We need to clarify this internally - we will come back to you on price. 

Our current proposal is a price of €15.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, Lieferzeit 42 days, delivery DAP. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price. As an alternative, with a price of €15.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, Lieferzeit 42 days, delivery DAP. If you agree to 14 days payment, we can drop the price to €15.30, which beats your other offer.

Our Lieferzeit is 42 days. With overtime we can deliver in 21 days, at a premium. We have free capacity for your parts. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to?

Gruß
Claudia Aigner
Owner, Demo Drehteile GmbH

move.text:
Dear partner,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We received a lot of material; we looked at what bears on this part. We have already taken that volume change data into account, and we have already taken that should cost data into account. We appreciate your confirmation of the 6,000 units per year volume and your interest in a long-term partnership.

Our current Angebot stands at a price of €16.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days, delivery EXW.

As an alternative, to provide a more competitive price of EUR 15.50, we must maintain our standard lead time of 45 days. This option at our standard terms includes a price of €15.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, Lieferzeit 45 days, delivery EXW.

Could you please share the details of your should-cost estimate so we can better understand your target? Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data. Our price follows our main cost drivers: BAR-14021, WAGES-METAL. Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Best regards
Joanna Kaczmarek
Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.
